name: Kids Summer Learning Center (KSLC)
description_short: One-week summer enrichment classes for grades 3-8 at Somerset Berkley Regional High School, taught by area teachers. Most classes run 9:00-11:00 AM (Kids Kitchen to 11:30). Subjects include robotics, LEGO, Minecraft, cooking, music, art, writing, dance and flag football; sign up for one week or several. Open to all area students.

sources.note: Home page: 'Classes for Summer 2024'; 'one-week long summer classes'; scholarship program introduced in 2015.
FAQs: held at 625 County Street, Somerset, MA 02726; 'Most classes are from 9:00AM to 11:00AM'; 'grades 3 through 8'; (508) 324-3146; william.aguiar@ns.sbregional.org (also on the Contact page).
